posts.title: The Problem Isn’t AI. It’s Lazy Creators
posts.description: There is a clear backlash against software written by AI, from developers and consumers alike. The reality, however, is that most, if not all, software will be partly written by AI. It’s inevitable, and it would even be irresponsible not to use it.
